== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|A wand is a magical tool used by wizards to channel and focus their magic through the [[Aether]]. These implements serve as precision instruments, allowing a caster to direct spells toward specific targets or create focused elemental attacks, such as beams of water or concentrated bursts of light. While they provide accuracy and control for single-target spells, they are less effective for wide-area magic compared to a staff. Wands can also be used to manifest defensive seals, create illusory images, or trace runes and symbols in the air. Physically, wands vary significantly in appearance and construction. Some models possess a technological aesthetic, featuring metal plating, titanium, or [[steel]] that may buzz with energy. Others are crafted from organic materials like braided bone or gold-plated bone, while some appear as delicate silver instruments with gemstone tips. Certain wands are large enough to function like a staff, and some may even serve as symbolic items in digital environments. In certain social hierarchies, specific classes of magical focuses are reserved for members of the royal family or their advisors. While they are primary tools for combat and utility, a wand can also be used to perform tasks like sealing engines or blocking alarms.}}
